sentences.ar: الخالة بولي صرخت: توم! وين إنت؟
sentences.en: Aunt Polly shouted: Tom! Where are you?
She found him in the cupboard with his mouth full of jam.

sentences.ar: مسكته من قميصه وقالت: هلق شفتك.
sentences.en: She grabbed him by his shirt and said: now I have caught you.
Tom shouted: Auntie, look behind you!
She turned, and he jumped the fence and fled.
She stood alone and laughed in spite of herself.
